Package net.sf.sevenzipjbinding

Enum Class NCoderPropID

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<NCoderPropID>
net.sf.sevenzipjbinding.NCoderPropID
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<NCoderPropID>, Constable
public enum NCoderPropID extends Enum<NCoderPropID>
Enumeration of coder (compression method) property identifiers, mirroring 7-Zip's native NCoderPropID constants. Each constant carries the Java type of its value and the corresponding 7-Zip command-line option name.
Since:
9.20-2.00
Author:
